title: The spectral object of the vertical truncation tower
statement: Let C be abelian, with diagonal total complexes of all nonnegative double complexes. For each such K there is an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object Y. For all integers a≤b and n≥0, H^n_Y(a,b) is isomorphic to H^n(Tot(W[a,b)(K))), where W is [def-sp-double-complex-vertical-window] applied columnwise. Also H^n_Y(bottom,top) is isomorphic to H^n(Tot(K)). This asserts neither page calculations nor convergence.

proof.text: Construct the explicit EInt-indexed smart cutoff tower. Finite terms are totalized columnwise tau_{<b} cutoffs extended to integer degrees; bottom is zero, top is the total of columnwise extension-restriction. Canonical inclusions into top are monomorphic and nested, so their unique factors give a functor.

Precompose Mathlib HomotopyCategory.spectralObjectMappingCone with this tower and apply its homological functor to C. This supplies the spectral object and its exactness. For finite lower bounds use the cone-to-smart-interval homology comparison. For the whole interval the cone has zero source; its inclusion is an isomorphism onto the top complex. The explicit natural extension-restriction isomorphism identifies top homology with that of Tot(K).

Cutoffs ending at or below zero are zero termwise; their totals and mapping cones are zero. A smart interval starting at a has zero vertical terms below a; every total summand in degree n<a therefore vanishes. Transport this homology vanishing through the interval comparison, also when the upper bound is top. Bottom-to-anything has no lower-bound condition, and top-to-top vanishes by the isomorphism axiom. This proves both first-quadrant conditions.

lean.statement: theorem exists_verticalSpectralObject [∀ L : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ), L.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)] (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) : ∃ Y : CategoryTheory.Abelian.SpectralObject C EInt, Y.IsFirstQuadrant ∧ (∀ (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ), Nonempty ((Y.H n).obj (mk₁ (homOfLE (show (a : EInt) ≤ (b : EInt) from WithBotTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hab))) ≅ (HomologicalComplex₂.total (((verticalWindow a b).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty ((Y.H n).obj (mk₁ (homOfLE (bot_le : (⊥ : EInt) ≤ ⊤))) ≅ (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n))
